episodes.synopsis: Otori Sakko is a second-year student at Enoshima Academy, a private school for gifted students. Cocky and fearless, he is often shunned by his peers. One day, Sakko's recently deceased friend Sayo reappears and starts talking about 12,000 year-old myths.
episodes.title: What She Told

episodes.synopsis: The Elementals learn that the beast they fought is a Shadow Angel from mythic space. Their role is to fuse the Vector Machines into Aquarion and fight those enemies back. Sakko recalls playing with Sayo, Momohime, and a certain robot in an Enoshima cave.
episodes.title: A  Wish for Carnations

episodes.synopsis: The universe's ability to self-correct made Sayo's funeral occur before her death. It seems only the Elements are aware that Sayo was in their class, but when Momohime asks about it, the students share a vision of a super-civilization with winged beings.
episodes.title: Not Yet Knowing

episodes.synopsis: After piloting Aquarion together, Momohime and Rimiya sense a special connection to each other. They go on a date to try to understand their feelings.
episodes.title: A Sacred Bond

episodes.synopsis: The Elements battle another Mythic Beast and make a strange new friend while pondering their school's legends.
episodes.title: Somebody

episodes.synopsis: Hana keeps trying to attack Momohime and Sun makes mysterious comments about the beasts to the other Elements.
episodes.title: Tell Me Your Secret

episodes.synopsis: Hana starts questioning the nature of the Beasts while Sun draws mesmerized students to a mysterious activity.
episodes.title: What Our World Is

episodes.synopsis: Momohime urges Sakko to explore his feelings for Sun before another Beast attack threatens the whole universe.
episodes.title: A Dream Inside an Egg

episodes.synopsis: Sakko and friends find themselves trapped in a hellish landscape where they start to feel unfamiliar emotions.
episodes.title: At the End of Reincarnation

episodes.synopsis: As Sakko and friends learn more about their past, they ponder ways to prevent the destructive union of worlds.
episodes.title: Inside a Totally Changed World

episodes.synopsis: With Momohime's fate in doubt, the Elements recall past experiences and face a potentially devastating battle.
episodes.title: With a Promise from Long Ago

episodes.synopsis: The World Awakening Council reveals its agenda while past and present overlap as the universes begin to unite.
episodes.title: Let Us Share a Myth about Love
